title: SonifyV1
description: Turns traffic into music. Computer-vision detection tracks vehicles across a live camera or video file; user-drawn trigger lines fire notes as vehicles cross them, with trajectory trails, velocity vectors and occlusion tracking feeding a tempo-synchronized microtonal scale engine. Outputs MIDI and OSC, so it drives any DAW or synth.
technical: C++, ML vehicle detection (confidence threshold + frame skip), multi-line crossing triggers, occlusion tracking, microtonal scale manager, MIDI + OSC output, USB/IP camera or file input
